```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 6)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(CATALYST); library(ggplot2); library(SingleCellExperiment) })
for (f in list.files(params$rdir, "\\.R$", full.names = TRUE)) source(f)
st <- readRDS(params$state)
sce <- st$sce
show <- function(p) draw_any(p)
```

## Data

```{r}
ei <- get_ei(sce)
cat(sprintf("%s cells, %d samples, %d type markers, %d state markers\n",
            format(ncol(sce), big.mark = ","), nrow(ei), length(type_markers(sce)), length(state_markers(sce))))
knitr::kable(ei)
```

## Quality control

```{r, fig.height=4}
plotCounts(sce, group_by = "sample_id", color_by = "condition")
```

```{r}
pbMDS(sce, color_by = "condition", label_by = "sample_id")
show(plotExprHeatmap(sce, features = "type", by = "sample_id", scale = "last", bars = TRUE))
```

## Clustering

```{r, eval = !is.null(st$k) && st$k %in% clustering_names(sce), fig.height=8}
show(plotExprHeatmap(sce, features = "type", by = "cluster_id", k = st$k, scale = "first", bars = TRUE))
if (!is.null(st$dr) && st$dr %in% reducedDimNames(sce)) print(plotDR(sce, st$dr, color_by = st$k))
plotAbundances(sce, k = st$k, by = "sample_id", group_by = "condition")
```

## Batch correction

```{r, eval = !is.null(metadata(sce)$batch)}
b <- metadata(sce)$batch
cat("Method:", b$method, "| variable:", b$var, "\n")
if ("UMAP" %in% reducedDimNames(sce)) print(plot_batch_umaps(sce, b$var))
if (!is.null(st$diag)) knitr::kable(st$diag$summary, digits = 3)
```

## Differential abundance

```{r, eval = !is.null(st$da)}
m <- st$da$model
cat(sprintf("Method: %s | clustering: %s | %s vs %s | covariates: %s | random: %s\n",
            st$da$method, st$da$k, m$comp, m$ref, paste(setdiff(m$fixed, m$condition_var), collapse = ", ") %||% "none",
            m$random %||% "none"))
knitr::kable(st$da$table, digits = 4)
print(plot_da_forest(st$da$table, st$fdr_da))
print(plot_paired_props(sce, st$da$k, m))
```

## Differential state

```{r, eval = !is.null(st$ds)}
m <- st$ds$model
cat(sprintf("Method: %s | clustering: %s | %s vs %s\n", st$ds$method, st$ds$k, m$comp, m$ref))
sig <- st$ds$table[!is.na(st$ds$table$p_adj) & st$ds$table$p_adj < st$fdr_ds, ]
cat(nrow(sig), "significant cluster-marker pairs at FDR <", st$fdr_ds, "\n")
knitr::kable(head(st$ds$table, 40), digits = 4)
print(plot_volcano(st$ds$table, "delta_median", st$fdr_ds, xlab = "Difference in median expression"))
```

## Marker enrichment (MEM)

```{r, eval = !is.null(st$mem), fig.height=8}
show(plot_mem(st$mem))
```

## Parameters & reproducibility

```{r}
str(st$log, max.level = 3, give.attr = FALSE)
sessionInfo()
```
